tasks.short: Prepare and check financial reports against accounting records, supporting evidence and reporting standards.

steps.what: Export the trial balance and ledger detail from the {ERP}.
Collect supporting schedules and evidence from the {DOCS}.
Tie report figures to balances and check totals in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Assess accounting treatments, disclosures and material exceptions against standards in the {DOCS}.
Discuss unusual balances and missing explanations with budget owners.
Prepare the financial report and review findings in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Validated report tables, accounting assessment, management explanations and approved report template.
loop.output: Draft commentary and review findings with references to evidence.
loop.check: Code ties every figure to validated tables; the accountant checks claims, omissions and source references.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per report section; unsupported claims return to the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables use deterministic templates, but explanations and findings require writing from varied evidence.

steps.what: Review and approve the financial report for internal issue in the {DOCS}.

tasks.design: A scheduled job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reads the {ERP}, assembles evidence from the {DOCS} and produces deterministic tie-outs and report tables. A bounded drafting loop adds source-linked commentary, while the accountant handles accounting judgements and discussions. The {WORKFLOW} routes the exact report version to the controller before internal issue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Account mappings, report versions and evidence links needed bespoke setup. Existing checks covered arithmetic better than accounting treatments and explanations.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding can reduce the effort of building mappings and report generators. Existing interfaces and bounded drafting make a small implementation practical without changing professional standards.
tasks.still_hard: Materiality, estimates, consolidation adjustments and incomplete evidence remain difficult. External audit conclusions and statutory reporting need their own authorised review and issuance process.
tasks.human_edge: The accountant weighs conflicting evidence and challenges explanations that look plausible but lack substance.

ambition.what: Weekly review of emerging accounting estimate changes with the controller.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from assembling packs to investigating material movements and discussing estimates. The accountant can recommend earlier corrections; final accounting policy and report approval rights stay with the existing approvers.

reach.task: Define a finance exception dashboard with drill-through to ledger evidence.
reach.learn: Data lineage, refresh controls and the difference between accounting balances and operational measures.

reach.task: Prepare a short decision brief on an emerging estimate change.
reach.learn: Decision thresholds, uncertainty ranges and the financial manager's reporting responsibilities.

evidence.claim: DataSnipper supports evidence extraction and tests of details with team review and sign-off.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported statement tick-and-tie falling from eight to two hours; this is a vendor-published case.
Arithmetic tie-outs can be deterministic, while accounting estimates and materiality require professional judgement.

assumptions: The main setting is an internal finance team; external auditors retain separate responsibilities.
Today’s effort includes substantial judgement, consistent with the supplied priors, despite structured ledger inputs.
The ranges cover one entity and one report family, not a full consolidation replacement.
GDPR controls apply to personal data in evidence. Access work includes checking national employee consultation requirements.
unknowns: Which reporting standards, entities and consolidation processes apply.
Whether ledger exports include stable account, entity and period identifiers.
Who approves reports and whether external issuance is within scope.
Whether employee consultation is required under applicable national rules.
research_questions: Which deterministic tests best cover the applicable report formats and disclosure requirements?
What published evaluations measure factual accuracy in source-linked financial commentary?
new_work: Maintain account mappings and report templates.
Review drafted commentary and evidence references.
Resolve missing evidence and failed tie-outs.
Check access logs and changes to reporting rules.

tasks.short: Receive, check, approve and post supplier invoices, then release authorised payments.

steps.what: Receive supplier invoices through the shared {EMAIL} inbox.
Enter invoice fields and attach the source invoice in the {ERP}.
Check duplicates, tax fields and purchase matching in the {ERP}.
Resolve coding and matching exceptions using evidence and correspondence in the {EMAIL}.

loop.input: Invoice exception, invoice description, purchase evidence and relevant correspondence.
loop.output: Proposed account coding or exception resolution with evidence references.
loop.check: Validate accounts, amounts and purchase references; the accountant approves the resolution before recording it.
loop.stop: One proposal and one revision per exception; ambiguity or missing evidence returns to the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules handle standard matches, but varied descriptions and correspondence can explain exceptional purchases.

steps.what: Approve the expense and receipt confirmation in the {ERP}.
Post the approved invoice and include it in a payment proposal in the {ERP}.
Review and release the payment batch through the {BANK}.

tasks.design: Configure invoice intake from the {EMAIL}, supported document capture and matching in the {ERP}, with purchase evidence from the {PROCUREMENT}. A bounded loop proposes resolutions for free-text exceptions; the accountant approves those resolutions and budget owners approve expenses. The {ERP} prepares payment proposals, and the treasurer authorises release through the {BANK}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supplier documents, incomplete purchase records and inconsistent approval routing created manual work. Much of the available invoice automation was only partly configured.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing capture, matching and approval features can handle the standard path. AI coding lowers the effort of connecting evidence and adding a narrow exception helper.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed deliveries, non-purchase-order spend and supplier identity checks remain costly. Bank detail changes require independent verification; invoice text cannot authorise them.
tasks.human_edge: The accountant recognises when a formally valid invoice represents an unsupported or disputed expense.

ambition.what: A weekly supplier payment-readiness clinic for budget owners.

tasks.altitude: The accountant spends less time entering invoices and more time clearing recurring purchase problems. They can recommend fixes to receipt and approval practices; spending and payment authority remain with existing approvers.

reach.task: Improve invoice intake completeness and purchase-reference quality.
reach.learn: Document capture confidence, duplicate controls and purchase matching.

reach.task: Prepare a reliable near-term view of approved supplier payments.
reach.learn: Payment cutoffs, liquidity priorities and bank authorisation controls.

evidence.claim: Invoice matching, duplicate checks and approval routing can use configured rules and existing finance software.
Skin Pharm moved spreadsheet orders and chat approvals into Ramp; the vendor reports a shorter month-end close. This is adjacent workflow evidence from a US case.

assumptions: The {ERP} has supported invoice capture, payable posting and approval features.
Unsupported document formats are sent to manual entry rather than accepted unchecked.
The mailbox share exceeds the supplied weak prior because intake and exception correspondence use it.
Separate people or authorised roles approve spending and release payments.
Access work covers GDPR and checks applicable national employee consultation rules.
unknowns: Whether supported capture and matching features are licensed and configured.
The share of invoices with purchase orders and reliable goods receipts.
Who independently verifies supplier payment details.
Which payment interfaces and approval limits apply.
Whether the company requires employee consultation for the proposed workflow.
research_questions: What capture accuracy is documented for the invoice formats and languages in scope?
Which payment interfaces support batch integrity checks and separate authorisation?
new_work: Review exception proposals and unsupported invoices.
Maintain matching tolerances, account mappings and approval routes.
Resolve failed imports and duplicate intake records.
Monitor payment-proposal integrity and access permissions.

tasks.short: Reconcile account balances, investigate differences and record approved adjustments.

steps.what: Export account balances and transaction detail from the {ERP}.
Download statements from the {BANK}.
Match entries and calculate differences in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Inspect supporting evidence in the {DOCS} to explain unmatched entries.

loop.input: Unmatched entries and a bounded set of related documents.
loop.output: Proposed explanations and evidence links for each exception.
loop.check: Code verifies amounts, dates and identifiers; the accountant checks the proposed accounting explanation.
loop.stop: At most two passes over supplied evidence per exception; unresolved items remain open.
loop.why_not_simpler: Deterministic matching covers explicit references; narrative evidence can explain timing and misclassification.

steps.what: Clarify unresolved entries with the responsible team through the {EMAIL}.
Submit adjustments for approval and post authorised corrections in the {ERP}.
Update the separate reconciliation status tracker in the {SPREADSHEET}.

tasks.design: Configure statement feeds from the {BANK} and matching in the {ERP}, with explicit tolerances and reproducible reconciliation workpapers. A bounded loop reads supporting evidence from the {DOCS} and proposes explanations; the accountant investigates unresolved items and the controller approves adjustments. Reconciliation status comes from the {ERP} and its approval records, removing the separate {SPREADSHEET} tracker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reliable matching needed stable references, clean opening balances and agreed tolerances. Evidence and status tracking were spread across files and correspondence.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured feeds and matching remove repeated downloads and arithmetic. AI coding makes evidence links and exception views cheaper to add, while a bounded loop can read narrative explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Old unexplained balances, many-to-many matches and incorrect source postings need investigation. A close balance alone does not prove that the accounting treatment is correct.
tasks.human_edge: The accountant distinguishes genuine timing differences from errors and resists unsupported write-offs.

ambition.what: Weekly escalation of ageing suspense balances to the controller.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts toward unresolved balances and source-process failures. The accountant gains an earlier escalation rhythm; journal approval and write-off authority stay with existing approvers.

reach.task: Identify customer receipts that cannot be allocated to invoices.
reach.learn: Remittance references, customer disputes and receivables allocation rules.

reach.task: Assess exposure from persistent unreconciled balances.
reach.learn: Risk thresholds, loss scenarios and how to distinguish evidence gaps from confirmed losses.

evidence.claim: Configured transaction matching and deterministic arithmetic can produce reconciliation workpapers and exception queues.
DataSnipper supports linking accounting tests to document evidence with human review.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported 40–50% time savings on tests of details; this is adjacent evidence, not a reconciliation forecast.

assumptions: The representative task includes bank and selected balance-sheet reconciliations.
The {ERP} supports matching rules and a reviewable reconciliation status.
Only the duplicate tracker vanishes; investigation remains substantial, contrary to a broad reading of the supplied disappearance prior.
Automatic matches retain source links and do not authorise unexplained write-offs.
Access work covers GDPR and checks applicable national employee consultation rules.
unknowns: Which accounts, currencies and entities are in scope.
Whether bank feeds and stable transaction identifiers are available.
The volume and age of unresolved balances.
Which journal and write-off approval limits apply.
Whether a separate tracker can be retired and whether national consultation requirements apply.
research_questions: Which matching approaches handle many-to-many settlements while preserving an understandable audit trail?
What published methods measure false matches and missed discrepancies in reconciliation systems?
new_work: Review proposed explanations and investigate unsupported matches.
Monitor feed completeness and opening-balance controls.
Reopen reconciliations when source records change.

tasks.short: Calculate tax liabilities, prepare and review returns, file them and arrange authorised payments.

steps.what: Extract tax balances and transaction detail from the {ERP}.
Collect tax schedules, prior returns and supporting evidence from the {DOCS}.
Read evidence and record relevant tax facts in the {SPREADSHEET}.

loop.input: A fixed evidence pack and defined tax fact fields.
loop.output: Tax facts with document references and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Validate amounts, dates, entity identifiers and source references; the accountant approves facts before use.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; missing or conflicting facts return to the accountant.
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured exports use mappings, but relevant facts also appear in varied contracts and narrative documents.

steps.what: Calculate liabilities and populate return fields in the {OTHER} tax preparation system.
Assess uncertain tax treatments and document positions in the {DOCS}.
Review the adjusted return and reconcile it to tax workpapers in the {OTHER} tax system.
Approve the exact return version for filing in the {OTHER} tax preparation system.
Submit the approved return through the {GOV_PORTAL} and retain its receipt.
Authorise the tax payment through the {BANK}.

tasks.design: A deterministic integration brings balances from the {ERP} into the {OTHER} tax preparation system, while a bounded loop extracts source-linked facts from the {DOCS}. Configured tax rules calculate liabilities and generate returns; people assess uncertain treatments and approve the exact filing version. The accountant submits through the {GOV_PORTAL}, and the treasurer separately authorises payment through the {BANK}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tax mappings, evidence collection and changing national rules required continuing maintenance. Portal access and professional responsibility limited unattended filing.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing tax software already handles supported calculations and forms. AI coding reduces mapping and validation work, while bounded extraction can assist with varied supporting documents.
tasks.still_hard: Cross-border transactions, uncertain positions and rule changes remain expensive. Filing interfaces and delegated authority vary by jurisdiction; GDPR and the EU AI Act apply to relevant processing and AI use.
tasks.human_edge: The accountant interprets uncertain facts, weighs defensible tax positions and knows when specialist advice is needed.

ambition.what: A pre-transaction tax review for planned cross-border purchases.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from gathering facts and populating returns toward reviewing transactions before commitments. The accountant gains earlier advisory involvement; tax-position approval, filing authority and payment rights remain separately assigned.

reach.task: Prepare a jurisdiction-specific return and supporting tax position memo.
reach.learn: Local tax rules, filing requirements and evidence standards.

reach.task: Estimate tax cash outflows for the rolling forecast.
reach.learn: Payment calendars, tax timing differences and forecast uncertainty.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas assists with income and corporate tax returns while the user remains responsible; the digest describes a Netherlands capability.
Supported tax calculations and return population can use deterministic rules; uncertain tax positions require professional interpretation.
GDPR and the EU AI Act apply across the EU; national tax, filing and employee consultation rules vary.

assumptions: The first implementation covers one jurisdiction and one supported return family.
The {OTHER} tax preparation system has maintained rules and supported import formats.
Tax calculations use configured rules rather than model-generated arithmetic.
The supplied high automation prior applies mainly to preparation; judgement, authorisation and portal filing remain distinct.
Access estimates include tax-system permissions, filing credentials and checking national employee consultation requirements.
unknowns: Which jurisdictions, tax types and filing frequencies apply.
Whether maintained tax software and supported imports are available.
Who may approve tax positions, sign returns and use filing credentials.
Whether authorised machine filing interfaces exist.
Whether employee consultation is required under applicable national rules.
research_questions: Which official filing specifications and tax-software import formats cover the selected return family?
What published evaluations test extraction of tax-relevant facts across the required document languages?
new_work: Maintain ledger-to-tax mappings and versioned calculation rules.
Review extracted facts and unresolved tax questions.
Run regression checks when tax rules or forms change.
Retain approval versions, filing receipts and payment evidence.
Manage filing credentials and delegated access.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward evidence quality, difficult accounting treatments and earlier advice to operational teams. Existing sign-off rights remain in place; any broader authority requires an explicit delegation.
reach: Work with Business Intelligence Analysts on source-linked finance exception views.
Work with Treasurers on reliable payment and tax cash forecasts.
Work with Budget Analysts on the financial effects of proposed transactions.
Work with Tax Preparers on jurisdiction-specific evidence and filing requirements.
skills_to_grow: Design deterministic controls and test their failure cases.
Trace reported figures to source records and approved versions.
Review model drafts for unsupported claims and missing evidence.
Explain accounting uncertainty in short decision briefs.
Understand integration permissions, GDPR and applicable national consultation rules.
role.ambitious_version: Become the finance adviser who brings emerging accounting, payment and tax issues to decision-makers early, supported by reproducible records and source-linked evidence.
